sentences.en: Part of her treatment required that she undergo radiation therapy.
sentences.zh: 她治疗的一部分需要接受放射治疗。

sentences.en: Abnormal levels of radiation have been recorded in the area.
sentences.zh: 该地区记录到了异常高的辐射水平。

sentences.en: Without proper radiation protection, humans can't venture out in deep space.
sentences.zh: 如果没有适当的防辐射措施，人类无法在深空环境中活动。

senses.zh: 辐射，放射线；辐射的热（或能量等）；放射疗法；辐射形进化，发散状分化
